audience: businesses that send SMS and faxes and keep an address book in Notifyre

useCases.title: Check which texts were sent and if they were delivered
useCases.text: The AI lists sent SMS with recipient, status and cost, filtered by status and date, and opens one for the delivery status of every recipient.

useCases.title: Read the replies to your texts
useCases.text: The AI lists SMS replies received on your numbers, with the reply text if you ask for it. You see what customers answered.

useCases.title: See sent and received faxes
useCases.text: The AI lists faxes sent from the account with status and failure reason, and faxes received with sender, number, time and pages.

useCases.title: Check SMS prices, numbers and sender IDs before sending
useCases.text: The AI lists the price of one SMS per country, your SMS numbers and approved sender IDs. It helps you work out the cost of a send.

useCases.title: Send an SMS to up to 10 numbers
useCases.text: The AI sends one text to 1 to 10 mobile numbers. This sends real messages and spends your prepaid balance, so check the price list first.

useCases.title: Add contacts and groups to the address book
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact with names and numbers, creates a group, and adds existing contacts to groups. Adding a contact to a group does not send anything.
